name: pykrete
displayName: Pykrete — Static schema checking for Python
description: Static schema checking for PySpark .pyk files — diagnostics, hover, completion, go-to-definition, quick-fixes — plus general Python language features from a bundled, multiplexed Python engine.

pykrete.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the pykrete-lsp binary. If empty, the extension searches the workspace's target/release and target/debug directories, then falls back to 'pykrete-lsp' on PATH.

pykrete.pythonServer.path.description: Absolute path to a Python language server (basedpyright-langserver / pyright-langserver) for pykrete-lsp to embed for general Python features. If empty, the basedpyright bundled with this extension is used (requires Node.js on PATH). pykrete's schema features work regardless.

enumDescriptions: No checking — pykrete and the embedded Python engine both stay silent.
Every error pykrete and the engine report by default.
Standard plus advisory checks that are too noisy for everyday use.
pykrete.typeCheckingMode.description: How strict pykrete's checking is. A single knob driving both pykrete's own schema checks and the embedded Python engine's typeCheckingMode.

pykrete.trace.server.description: Trace LSP communication between the editor and pykrete-lsp.
